audit_items.proof_trace: OZ VestingWalletUpgradeable enforces the invariant via `releasable = vestedAmount - released`, where `vestedAmount = _vestingSchedule(histBalance, ts)`. The custom epoch `_vestingSchedule` is bounded at all branches: case 1 returns exactly `_totalAllocation`; case 2 returns `((currentEpoch-1) * alloc) / N` where `currentEpoch-1 <= N-1`, so the result is strictly < `alloc`; case 3 returns 0. Therefore `released(token)` can never exceed `_totalAllocation` (historical balance), and the invariant holds for both `LegionLinearVesting` and `LegionLinearEpochVesting`.
